description: Funding per UTC day of the largest coins of one venue (the funding heatmap), with the cumulative funding of each coin over the window: what a 1x long paid per dollar of position (negative = it received), and the same as an average annualised rate. Use it for "which coins paid the most funding this month?".

days.description: Window in UTC days up to today (default 30). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

limit.description: Number of coins, largest open interest first (default 10, at most 30).

name: get_funding_heatmap

coins.description: Per coin: coin, openInterestUsd, cumulative (funding, apr, hoursCovered, hoursInRange, daysCovered).

days.description: Window served in days (after the plan clamp).

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

preparing.description: Coins still being prepared from the stored history.
